The RCE-class code-execution tool (issue #1495) is observed at pinned 0.0.77 as browser_run_code_unsafe; the first-deploy deny used the wrong exact name (browser_run_code) and did not match, so the tool loaded ask-gated only. _provenance_claude_ai_connectors: The claude.ai account-connector rules (the mcp__claude_ai_* ask floor, the 21 exact-string Gmail/Drive ask entries, and the six mcp__claude_ai_* deny tripwires) enter via TWO curation records: curation/claude-code/records/gmail.md and curation/claude-code/records/google-drive.md (tending third-party-curation, beat 2026-07-09-3, admitted with tailoring by the Examiner at Fable 2026-07-09, deny-removal user-approved 2026-07-09 after classifier escalation). Design: the single blanket deny mcp__claude_ai_* is REPLACED by a layered rule set. Everything account-connector is ASK — the catch-all mcp__claude_ai_* ask floor gates current-and-future connector tools; the 21 exact-string entries (13 Gmail + 8 Drive, enumeration of 2026-07-09) are startup-typo-check tripwires (glob rules are exempt from the startup check, exact strings are not — a mismatch surfaces a warning). The six deny entries are TRIPWIRES, not boundaries: mcp__claude_ai_Google_Calendar__* and mcp__claude_ai_Supabase__* deny two un-curated connector classes wholesale; Gmail send*/delete* and Drive share*/delete* deny name-prefixed destructive/exfil classes that were NOT observed in the enumeration — if a future toolset move introduces them, the deny bites and the drift shows. No send/share/delete tool exists in the admitted enumeration; these denies pre-empt their arrival. No allow rules by decision (everything stays ask). Name-based rules re-verify against the live inventory at every deploy and every re-enumeration (the ledger-15 precedent; and download_file_content, not download_file, is the ledger-15 vindication this pass). Operator confinement is doctrinal, not structural — the deny/ask layer is the structural carrier.

SessionStart._provenance_compaction_marker: pursuit claude-code-cos-realization (contracts/2026-07-07-claude-code-cos-realization/), the user's word 2026-07-19 'Wire the hook and reword the bullet to key on its marker.' Closes the observability gap in the context-compaction recall trigger (30-retrieval.md): the session cannot tell from inside that a compaction happened, so the trigger was unobservable. SessionStart matcher 'compact' fires after any compaction (manual /compact or auto-compact) and injects its stdout into the model's context -- this hook writes a single ASCII marker line the reworded retrieval bullet keys on. Verified against the official hooks docs 2026-07-19: PostCompact CANNOT inject context (side-effects only), so SessionStart/compact is the injecting mechanism. Inline echo (not a hooks/ script) is the simplest form for a static one-line marker; ASCII-only for the PS 5.1 deploy pipeline.

hooks.command: echo "[compaction-marker] This session's context was just compacted into a summary. Retrieval rule: reground the load-bearing facts the current work rests on against their surfaces before relying on them."
